```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```
## Check the 3' end bias 
```{r}
library(jsonlite)
library(ggplot2)
# Read file 
file <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/004_alignment/all_plates_96w/mapping_bias/294478_S165.genes_TES_matrix.gz"

upstream <- 500
bin_size <- 10

mat <- read.table(gzfile(file), skip = 1, sep = "\t")
mean_signal <- colMeans(mat[, -(1:6)], na.rm = TRUE)

profile <- data.frame(
    position = (seq_along(mean_signal) - 1) * bin_size - upstream,
    signal = mean_signal
)

ggplot(profile, aes(x = position, y = signal)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    labs(title = "3' bias around TES (genes)", x = "Distance from TES (bp)", y = "Mean CPM signal") +
    theme_minimal()
```
## Plot along all samples
```{r}
indir <- "/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/004_alignment/all_plates_96w/mapping_bias"
all_files <- list.files(indir, pattern = "\\.te_TES_matrix\\.gz$", full.names = TRUE)

files <- sample(all_files, 100)

upstream <- 500
bin_size <- 10

get_profile <- function(file) {
    mat <- read.table(gzfile(file), skip = 1, sep = "\t")
    mean_signal <- colMeans(mat[, -(1:6)], na.rm = TRUE)
    data.frame(
        sample = sub("\\.genes_TES_matrix\\.gz$", "", basename(file)),
        position = (seq_along(mean_signal) - 1) * bin_size - upstream,
        signal = mean_signal
    )
}

all_profiles <- do.call(rbind, lapply(files, get_profile))

# Average signal across samples, per position
avg_profile <- aggregate(signal ~ position, data = all_profiles, FUN = mean)

ggplot(avg_profile, aes(x = position, y = signal)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "darkred") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    labs(title = "3' bias around TES (average of 100 samples)", x = "Distance from TES (bp)", y = "Mean CPM signal") +
    theme_minimal()
```
